title: basalt-plugin.json
description: A plugin's manifest, manifestVersion 1. Unknown top-level fields are ignored, so a later minor addition does not break an older engine; the hooks object and the endpoint are closed. Rules this schema cannot express are checked by the engine at basalt plugin add and at every start: a remote endpoint's host and port are in network.egress, a namespaced entity type starts with the manifest's own name, and a local endpoint's command is one of its files. See CONTRACT.md, Plugins, Manifest.

version.description: The plugin's version, semantic versioning, at most 64 bytes (the ledger records it).

protocol.description: The plugin protocol versions the plugin speaks. A v1 engine needs basalt-plugin/1 among them; initialize picks one.

hooks.description: The hooks the plugin serves, by hook name, at least one. wire.verdict is reserved and refused in v1. wire.detect may not share a manifest with feed.observe or approval.deliver.

allOf.$comment: One plugin that sees plain values on the wire and ledger events could pair them to learn which values are stored.
A detector never receives approval links.

endpoint.description: Where the plugin runs: exactly one of local or remote.

files.description: Every file a local plugin ships, by path relative to the manifest's directory, with its SHA-256. A remote plugin ships no files.

egress.description: The host:port entries the plugin may reach. Empty means none.

allOf.$comment: A remote plugin carries no files; a local one lists every file it ships.

hookDeclaration.description: What a plugin declares for one hook. Each hook's contract fixes which of these fields it takes; unknown fields are ignored.

contract.description: The hook's message contract and its major version.

roles.description: wire.detect only: VALUE spans are tokenized; NAME_CUE spans are evidence for the dictionary and tokenize nothing alone.

entityTypes.description: wire.detect and classify.suggest: the entity types the plugin may return.

entityType.description: A well-known token type, or a type namespaced by the plugin's own name (acme-ner.EMPLOYEE_ID). The engine checks the prefix is this manifest's name.

url.description: https only, with no user name or password, query or fragment.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the manifest's directory: slash-separated, no segment starting with a dot, so no .. and no absolute path.

hostPort.description: A lowercase host name, an IPv4 address or a bracketed IPv6 address, then a port.
